items.title: Write product README with capabilities and non-goals
items.notes: Session zero, build, campaign fit, GM handoff; Player/GM modes; tech intent; rules sources.

items.title: Draft phased delivery roadmap through polish and share
items.notes: Phases 0–6 plus later non-goals and open decisions in ROADMAP.md.

items.title: Define early-scope exclusions and campaign-safe non-goals
items.notes: No full feat/spell/equipment catalogs; no Foundry/Pathbuilder; no multi-PC balancing; no player-facing ritual spoilers.

items.title: Document Player and GM mode audiences and content
items.notes: Player: invitation, questions, build, soft tips. GM: same build plus scapegoat/stake and deity hooks.

items.title: Record Vite + TypeScript and attribute-engine reuse intent
items.notes: Local-first static app; port normalizeBuild/ancestryRule/calculate; Player Core catalogs first; share URL + JSON/Markdown exports.

items.title: Add agent-ready docs, AGENTS.md, and name-roadmap JSON
items.notes: docs/overview through roadmap-format; roadmap/*.json; README Documentation links.

items.title: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript local-first app
items.notes: New app or monorepo sibling next to pf2e-point-buy-calc. Node 22.18+ or 24+. Exit: app runs locally.

items.title: Design a Pharasma-inspired favicon and header emblem
items.notes: Share one SVG between the header and browser tab. Combine Pharasma's spiraling comet with a fractured silver masquerade mask.

items.title: Illustrate the shell with a fractured mirror and a candle spiral
items.notes: Replace the star cluster with a static silver filigree mirror inspired by the arrival at House Verathe.

items.title: Frame the favicon and header mask with a fractured mirror
items.notes: Replace the comet with fractured oval glass inspired by the shell backdrop.

items.title: Replace the backdrop candles with silver sparkles
items.notes: Set four-point glints along the mirror's spiral.

items.title: Extract or copy attribute engine from pf2e-point-buy-calc
items.notes: Port options, normalizeBuild, ancestryRule, calculate, and serialize/parse. Do not reimplement boost math.

items.title: Port smoke tests for Remaster boost math
items.notes: Reuse or port test/build.test.ts from the point-buy calculator. Exit: empty shell loads a default level-1 build.

items.title: Add shared Build and SessionZero types
items.notes: Mechanical Build plus new SessionZero answers for invitation, stake, art, faith, mask.

items.title: Add Player / GM mode toggle with GM panel hidden by default
items.notes: Player-safe default; GM wiring only when toggled.

items.title: Ship player-safe invitation blurb and guided questions
items.notes: Why accept; who matters (or self as watched); art/craft; optional deity (Pharasma / Nocticula / Black Butterfly / none); mask concept. No ritual spoilers.

items.title: Persist session-zero answers in localStorage and export JSON/Markdown
items.notes: Player can finish questions and take answers with them.

items.title: Guide players through Pathfinder 2e Remaster character creation step by step
items.notes: The invitation and character concept guide ships in Phase 1 with progress and editable review. Extend the same flow through the mechanical build for players with tabletop experience who are new to Pathfinder 2e Remaster. Introduce rules at the relevant choice, including ancestry boosts and class key attributes.

items.title: Port attribute creator UI from the point-buy calculator
items.notes: Ancestry / background / class / level / milestones / voluntary flaws. Player Core and Player Core 2 first; custom rows otherwise.

items.title: Save build choices and progress across refreshes
items.notes: Store the mechanical build and current guide step separately from session-zero answers.

items.title: Add share link and printable attribute ledger for the mechanical build
items.notes: Mechanical side only; Exit: full Remaster attribute planning works in-app.

items.title: Remove the mode switch from the player interface
Score builds against night demands (Will, Perception, social, Stealth/Thievery)
items.notes: Also cover Athletics climax interventions, optional Religion, Performance flavor. Same scores for player and GM.

items.title: Place the campaign title above the app name
items.notes: Replace the invitation line and remove the repeated title below the app name.

items.title: Suggest campaign-fit backgrounds and classes as hints not locks
items.notes: Backgrounds e.g. Artist, Entertainer, Noble, Acolyte, Detective; classes e.g. Bard, Rogue, Investigator, Oracle, Witch, Cleric, Swashbuckler.

items.title: Describe the three deities on the faith step
items.notes: Give a brief, player-safe description of Pharasma, Nocticula, and the Black Butterfly.

items.title: Flag builds that lean hard into combat-as-default
items.notes: Show an advisory for finished builds with a strong attack attribute, another high physical modifier, and less support for Wisdom, Charisma, and Intelligence checks.

items.title: Add level-appropriate skill increase planner mapped to campaign fit
items.notes: Completed attributes unlock level-1 training, named Lore skills, class-based increases, and Intelligence training. Planned skill ranks and base modifiers appear in campaign fit. The plan saves in the local draft.

items.title: Export and restore a single player character file
items.notes: A versioned JSON file combines session-zero answers, attributes, planned skills, and guide progress. It supports unfinished characters and requires confirmation before replacing the browser draft.

items.title: Polish tone and CSS for a masquerade-adjacent readable UI
items.notes: Use a midnight-blue masthead, silver progress bars, and a framed invitation with a mirror wax seal. Apply consistent guide headings and panels, and fit the skill table to narrow screens.
